story: You are a researcher at the Mayo Clinic, conducting a longitudinal study called 'Efficacy of New Therapies Across Chronic Conditions.' You are collecting data from patients diagnosed with various chronic conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, asthma, arthritis, and depression to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments. The goal is to understand how treatment status, medication types, dosages, and other factors like patient age, severity of symptoms, and adherence impact outcomes such as blood pressure, glucose levels, and patient satisfaction.

variables.name: TreatedStatus
variables.desc: Whether the patient was treated with the new therapy

variables.name: DiagnosisType
variables.desc: The primary diagnosis of the patient

variables.name: MedicationType
variables.desc: The type of medication prescribed to the patient

variables.name: DosageAmount
variables.desc: The dosage amount of the medication taken by the patient

variables.name: GlucoseLevel
variables.desc: The patient's glucose level measured during the study period

variables.name: BloodPressureRange
variables.desc: The patient's blood pressure range measured during the study period

variables.name: SeverityLevel
variables.desc: The severity level of the patient's condition based on clinical assessment

variables.name: AgeGroup
variables.desc: The age group of the patient

variables.name: ResponseToTreatment
variables.desc: The patient's response to the treatment as assessed by the healthcare provider

variables.name: FollowUpVisits
variables.desc: Number of follow-up visits conducted after the initial treatment

variables.name: TreatmentDurationMonths
variables.desc: duration of treatment in months

variables.name: PatientGender
variables.desc: gender of the patient

variables.name: BaselineSymptomSeverity
variables.desc: severity of symptoms before treatment

variables.name: ComorbidConditions
variables.desc: presence of comorbid conditions

variables.name: AdherenceScore
variables.desc: adherence to treatment regimen

variables.name: SideEffectsReported
variables.desc: reported side effects during treatment

variables.name: FollowUpTestResults

variables.name: MedicationAdaptations

variables.name: PatientSatisfaction
variables.desc: patient satisfaction with treatment

variables.name: TreatmentCostRange
variables.desc: cost range of the treatment

questions.question: What does 'PatientSatisfaction' causally affect in this network (directly or indirectly)?
Is 'SideEffectsReported' independent of 'FollowUpTestResults' in this system?
Once we know the value of 'DiagnosisType', are 'FollowUpVisits' and 'TreatmentCostRange' statistically independent?
Once we know the value of 'DosageAmount', are 'GlucoseLevel' and 'FollowUpTestResults' statistically independent?
